verdict.rationale: Paperspace's official docs are hosted on docs.digitalocean.com, and a probe found a live llms.txt there (HTTP 200), so an agent can be pointed at an llms.txt index for the docs site that holds the Paperspace documentation. However, that llms.txt is a generic DigitalOcean-wide index with no evidence it covers Paperspace pages, and the Markdown variant of the Paperspace docs returns 404. Missing for 10: confirmation that llms.txt includes Paperspace-specific content, Markdown/agent-readable versions of Paperspace doc pages, a published OpenAPI spec, and any agent-oriented documentation or hands-on corroboration.
